item.title: Cade California Electronic Recalls Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.product: Cade California Electronic Recalls Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.summary: This recall involves California Cade Electronic Finger Lights, which contain three button cells batteries. The finger lights come in 50 pieces in a box in white, blue, red and green. The finger lights have "California Cade Electronic" and "Finger Flashlights" printed on labels located on the front of the package.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
